title: 第一卷 第8章 为分家做准备
slug: 一路逃荒一路富手握空间带飞全家
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

接下来的日子，沈鹿溪跟上了发条一样。

天不亮就上山，采草药、摘野菜、捡菌子。日头偏西才回来，筐里满满当当。

晚上趁家里人不注意，进空间打理灵田。

灵田里的野菜长得飞快，头一茬已经收了，紧跟着又种下了新的。

菜苗在灵泉水的浇灌下蹿得格外精神，叶片肥厚，颜色翠绿，跟外头地里那些蔫巴巴的完全不是一回事。

她把收下来的野菜分成两份。

品相好的留着去镇上卖，碎的和老的自家吃。

柳荞娘发现家里的饭桌上突然多了不少新鲜菜，问了一嘴，沈鹿溪说是山上采的。

柳荞娘信了，没再追问。

赶集的时候，沈鹿溪把野菜、草药、山菌一起背到镇上卖。

药铺的掌柜已经认识她了，见面就笑：“又来了？这回带了什么好货？”

草药的品相一次比一次好，掌柜给的价也跟着往上涨了一文。

茶叶那边进展更快。

沈鹿溪按照《农桑要术》上的法子反复练炒茶，头几锅焦了大半，后来慢慢摸到了火候的门道，炒出来的茶叶卷曲匀称，焦叶子从三成降到了不足一成。

茶铺掌柜验完货，眉毛挑得老高：“这才多久，你这炒工进步不小。”

他拈了一片放嘴里嚼了嚼，点头：“行，这批我给你七十文一两。”

比头一回涨了二十文。

沈鹿溪没急着点头：“掌柜的，上回您说炒好了能翻倍。这批品相您也看到了，七十文是不是还差点意思？”

掌柜被她噎了一下，笑骂道：“你这丫头，嘴皮子比你的茶还利。行，七十五文，不能再多了。你这茶虽然香气好，到底是野茶，卖相比不上正经茶园出的。等你哪天能把卖相也做上来，一百文我眼都不眨。”

七十五文一两，这批茶叶有四两出头，光茶叶就进账三百多文。

加上草药和野菜，这一趟赶集赚了将近五百文。

沈鹿溪照规矩，一半存进空间，一半留作家用和买粮。

空间窑洞里的铜板一点一点攒起来了，旁边还码了几袋粮食，是她每次赶集顺带买的糙米和杂粮。

不多，可积少成多。

除了赚钱囤粮，沈鹿溪还干了一件事。

她在自家那三亩薄田边上挖了个坑，按照《沤肥十二法》里的配方，把枯叶、草灰、鸡粪和泥土拌在一起，一层一层堆进去，最上面盖了一层厚土。

沈大山看见女儿在地头刨坑，过来帮忙。

“鹿溪，你这是干啥？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In the following days, Shen Luxi kept up with the situation like clockwork.

Go up the mountain before dawn to collect herbs, wild vegetables, and fungi.The sun came back westward, and the basket was full.

At night, when the family is not paying attention, I go into the space to take care of the spiritual field.

The wild vegetables in Lingtian are growing rapidly. The first crop has been harvested, and new ones have been planted soon after.

The vegetable seedlings are particularly energetic under the water of the spiritual spring. The leaves are thick and green in color, which is completely different from the wilted ones in the fields outside.

She divided the harvested wild vegetables into two portions.

Keep the good-quality ones to sell in the town, and eat the broken and old ones at home.

Liu Qiaoniang noticed that there were suddenly a lot of fresh vegetables on the dining table at home. She asked about them and Shen Luxi said they were picked from the mountains.

Liu Qiaoniang believed it and didn't ask any more questions.

When going to the market, Shen Luxi carried wild vegetables, herbs, and mountain mushrooms to the town to sell them.

The shopkeeper of the drug store already knew her, and he smiled when he saw her: "Here you go again? What good stuff did you bring this time?"

The quality of the herbs got better each time, and the price given by the shopkeeper also increased by a penny.

Progress is faster on the tea side.

Shen Luxi repeatedly practiced frying tea according to the method in "The Essential Techniques of Nongsang". Most of the pots were burnt in the first few pots. Later, he gradually got the hang of the heat. The fried tea leaves were evenly curled, and the burnt leaves were reduced from 30% to less than 10%.

After the tea shop owner inspected the goods, his eyebrows were raised high: "It's only been a while, you've made a lot of progress as a speculator."

He picked up a piece, put it in his mouth, chewed it, and nodded: "Okay, I'll give you seventy cents and one tael for this batch."

It was twenty cents higher than the first time.

Shen Luxi nodded without haste: "Shopkeeper, you said last time that it could be doubled after frying. You have also seen the quality of this batch. Isn't seventy coins not enough?"

The shopkeeper choked at her and scolded with a smile: "You girl, your words are better than your tea. Okay, seventy-five cents, no more. Although your tea has a good aroma, it is wild tea after all, and its sales cannot be compared with that of serious tea gardens. When you can make a good presentation one day, I won't blink an eye at a hundred cents."

Seventy-five cents a tael, this batch of tea leaves is just over forty taels, and the tea alone brings in more than 300 cents.

Including herbs and wild vegetables, I earned nearly 500 cash from this trip to the market.

According to the rules, Shen Luxi saves half of the money into the space and the other half for household expenses and food purchases.

The copper coins in the space cave house were accumulated little by little, and there were also a few bags of grain piled next to them. They were brown rice and grains that she bought every time she went to the market.

Not much, but a little can add up to a lot.

In addition to making money and hoarding food, Shen Luxi also did one more thing.

She dug a hole on the edge of her three-acre thin field. According to the formula in "The Twelve Methods of Fertilizing", she mixed the dead leaves, grass ash, chicken manure and soil together, and piled them in layer by layer, covering the top with a thick layer of soil.

Shen Dashan saw his daughter digging a hole in the field and came to help.

"Lu Xi, what are you doing?"
